english.meaning: counts one leg of a journey, such as a bus or train ride
english.note: 一程小巴 means a minibus ride.

exampleSentences.english: You need to change trains to get to the Leaning Tower of Pisa.
exampleSentences.traditional: 去哩個比薩斜塔嗰時要轉過另外一程火車呢。

exampleSentences.english: Much more expensive—the minibus ride I take costs twelve dollars.
exampleSentences.traditional: 貴好多，我搭嗰程小巴要十二蚊囖。
